# Sorting Through Value

Report 138 | Published 2024-06-09 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-6-9/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/138.json)

Reassessing lagging holdings and policy transmission.

The explicit review of losers improves accountability. CVS ultimately showed both an insurance earnings rebound and acquisition impairment, warranting mixed assessment. BMY patent risk materialized alongside new-product growth. OZK survived profitably but its loan cushions did not prevent losses.

**Coverage:** Read every section and chart label, including macro, Mt. Gox, crypto politics/Nostr, CVS, BMY, Bank OZK and EM rotation.
